title: Calibrate signal intensity ranges for Pattern A and Pattern B relational appraisal outputs
objective: Evaluate whether Pattern A (Contested Endorsement) and Pattern B (High-Intensity Unilateral Disclosure) warrant differentiated signal intensity shapes from the P0 baseline, record the calibration decision as a formal contract addendum, update docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Section 8 accordingly, and add or update tests that assert the final calibrated intensity ranges are stable and cannot silently drift.
exact_scope: The executor must (1) review the current identical output shapes of P0, Pattern A, and Pattern B (all surface/negative/low/mild_decrease/-1/0) and reason whether Pattern A or Pattern B should carry a distinct absorption level, arousal level, closeness_delta, or risk_delta given their friction mechanisms; (2) if differentiation is warranted, implement the revised output shape inside build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick() for the relevant pattern branch(es) in back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py; (3) update docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Sections 8.1.2, 8.2.2, and 8.4 to reflect the final calibrated ranges (whether changed or confirmed identical); (4) add at least 8 new tests in back/tests/ that pin the calibrated output field values for each pattern and confirm composition safety thresholds are still respected. If calibration concludes the patterns should remain identical to P0, that decision must be explicitly documented with rationale — silent no-change is not acceptable.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 fields are frozen — do not add, remove, or rename any field on AppraisalSignal.
T4 strong_decrease trust shift is a hard stop — no calibrated output may set trust_shift=strong_decrease.
Pattern A base risk_delta must remain 0 — no risk escalation is permitted on contested endorsement.
Pattern B base risk_delta must remain 0 — no risk escalation is permitted on high-intensity disclosure.
aftershock_days on the base signal must remain 0 for both patterns — the Phase 23 wake chain gate must stay closed on the signal alone path.
The _adjust_t4() function's hard-stop maps (_TRUST_MORE_GUARDED, _ABSORPTION_UP, closeness floor -2 / ceiling +2) must not be modified.
T3, T5, T6, T7, T8 bridge expansion is deferred — do not expand bridge coverage to any other tick.
T4 old deterministic path (P0: confrontation/withdrawal) is frozen — do not modify the P0 builder branch.
All existing 454 tests must continue to pass after calibration changes.
Do not modify docs/vision.md, docs/road_map.md, or any orchestrator SOT files.
acceptance_criteria: docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Section 8.1.2 contains an explicit calibrated signal shape for Pattern A, with a written rationale for why each field was set to its value (whether changed from P0 baseline or confirmed identical).

docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Section 8.2.2 contains an explicit calibrated signal shape for Pattern B, with a written rationale for why each field was set to its value (whether changed from P0 baseline or confirmed identical).
docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Section 8.4 is updated to reflect whether the shared safety invariants still hold after calibration.
If any pattern's output shape was changed, back/app/engines/tick_bridge.py reflects the new field values in the corresponding builder branch and the pattern catalog doc is also updated.

At least 8 new tests exist in back/tests/ that assert the exact calibrated output field values for Pattern A and Pattern B (absorption, valence, arousal, trust_shift, closeness_delta, risk_delta, aftershock_days, guidance_resonance).
The new tests include at least one test that verifies the composition safety classification (_classify_composition_safety) does not change for each pattern under standard T2+T4 collision conditions.
All tests pass: python3 -m pytest tests/ -v from back/ reports 0 failures.
The total test count is at or above 462 (454 existing + at least 8 new tests).
required_tests: Given a Pattern A event (endorsement + contested), when build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick is called, the returned signal's absorption field matches the calibrated value documented in Section 8.1.2.
Given a Pattern A event, the returned signal's trust_shift is exactly the calibrated value and does not exceed mild_decrease.
Given a Pattern A event, the returned signal's closeness_delta is exactly the calibrated value.
Given a Pattern A event, the returned signal's risk_delta is exactly 0.

Given a Pattern B event (disclosure + high + unilateral), when build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick is called, the returned signal's absorption field matches the calibrated value documented in Section 8.2.2.
Given a Pattern B event, the returned signal's trust_shift is exactly the calibrated value and does not exceed mild_decrease.
Given a Pattern B event, the returned signal's closeness_delta is exactly the calibrated value.

Given a Pattern A collision with T2 on the same relationship, the composition safety classification is 'safe' when combined intensity score is at or below 3, and does not become 'unsafe' solely from Pattern A signal without a carried residual.
Given a Pattern B collision with T2 on the same relationship, the composition safety classification is 'safe' when combined intensity score is at or below 3.
If Pattern A absorption differs from P0 surface absorption, a test verifies that the Phase 23 wake gate behavior is still correctly governed by the new absorption level.
non_goals: Do not expand Pattern A or Pattern B to produce strong_decrease trust shifts.
Do not add new T4 activation patterns beyond Pattern A and Pattern B — pattern catalog expansion is complete for P28.
Do not wire the world generator to produce qualifying social events — that is a separate concern deferred beyond P28.
Do not modify the T1 or T2 bridge builder functions.
Do not change the composition safety threshold values (combined<=3 safe, ==4 at_risk, >=5 unsafe) — those are established contracts.
Do not implement LLM runtime, probabilistic activation, or freeform natural-language appraisal.
